faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the GPRB Legal Executive recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the GPRB Legal Executive posts is 15th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Legal Executive post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be Law Graduates from a recognized university, registered with the Bar Council of Gujarat, and possess at least 5 years of advocate practice experience, with a minimum of 3 years in the Gujarat High Court. Basic computer knowledge is also required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Legal Executive position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Legal Executive post is 50 years as of 31st August 2026. There is no mention of minimum age or age relaxation in the provided details.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Legal Executive post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Legal Executive post announced by the Gujarat Police Recruitment Board.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Legal Executive role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Legal Executive position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 60,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the GPRB Legal Executive recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their application forms to the specified address.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Legal Executive posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Legal Executive posts will involve an Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for the GPRB Legal Executive recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee of Rs. 100/- for all categories, including General/OBC and SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the Gujarat Police Recruitment Board's official website. Links are provided in the "Important Links" section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for the Legal Executive position is contract-based.
